title: Human resources

basis.cite: No single U.S. statute. State breach-notification laws; CCPA/CPRA (Cal. Civ. Code 1798.100 et seq.) for California employees; GDPR Art. 4(1) and Art. 9 for EU staff
basis.summary: Personal information generally means a name combined with a government ID, account number or similar; GDPR covers any information relating to an identifiable person, with special categories (health, ethnicity, union membership and others) given extra protection.
Employee medical information must be kept confidential and separate from personnel files.

identifiers.treatment: remove prior employers and referees' firms

caveats: In a small team, a job title or a described incident identifies the person on its own.
Special-category details (health, religion, union membership) are not identifiers and are not removed, but may need separate handling.
note: A starting point drawn from the cited texts, not legal advice. Have counsel confirm the list for your jurisdiction and use before relying on it.
